name: blur_filter
description: The blur filter's settings: Blur matching photos (on/off), save the rules (edited through album_rules, with the live count), remove the filter. Reached by: app go_to photos, then photos blur_filter (or the account menu's Blur filter).

actions.name: back
actions.description: Leave the page, as its back button does (unsaved rules are dropped)

actions.name: remove
actions.description: Forget the filter (nothing is blurred any more), as Remove filter does. Only once saved

actions.name: save
actions.description: Save the rules (album_rules' state) as the blur filter, as Save filter does

actions.name: set_enabled
actions.description: Turn Blur matching photos on or off, as the switch does: saved at once once a filter exists, else with the first save

enabled.description: Blur matching photos (the switch); off keeps the rules

saved.description: A filter is saved on the server (remove is offered)

matching.description: Photos the rules being edited match now (the live count); the rules themselves are album_rules'

problem.description: What stops a save, or null

notice.description: What the last save, switch or removal did
